examples.translation: 我们全神贯注地扫视沙滩，寻找那些圆润而精致易损的宝物。

examples.text: Great cooking involves a subtle understanding of ingredients and delicate cooking that would be enormously challenging for robots.
examples.translation: 出色的烹饪需要对食材有细腻的理解和精细的烹调技巧，而这对机器人来说极具挑战。

meanings.text: 令人向往的；有吸引力的

examples.text: Sharpening judgment by absorbing and reflecting on law is a desirable component of a journalist's intellectual preparation.
examples.translation: 通过学习和反思法律来磨炼判断力，是记者知识准备中值得提倡的一部分。

examples.text: When we do manage to adopt and sustain a desirable behavior, that same strategy may not work for another behavior change.
examples.translation: 即使我们成功养成并维持了一种理想行为，同样的策略也未必适用于另一项行为改变。

examples.text: Not all plant parts are edible or desirable.
examples.translation: 并非植物的所有部分都可以食用，也并非都合乎需要。

senses.gloss: 令人向往的；有吸引力的

examples.text: The highly desirable beach community.
examples.translation: 这个非常令人向往的海滨社区。

examples.text: Today's social indices hardly suggest a dark and deteriorating social environment.
examples.translation: 今天的社会指标几乎不能说明社会环境正在变得黑暗并持续恶化。

examples.text: Their living standards have been deteriorating.
examples.translation: 他们的生活水平一直在恶化。

examples.text: People's deteriorating family finances.
examples.translation: 人们日益恶化的家庭财务状况。

examples.text: Old objects continue to deteriorate.
examples.translation: 旧物会继续老化、损坏。

meanings.text: 弥散的；分散的；广泛而不集中的

examples.text: Farming, pottery making, and metallurgy all originated in ancient Egypt and diffused throughout the world.
examples.translation: 有人曾错误地认为，农业、制陶和冶金都起源于古埃及并传播到世界各地。

examples.text: Alvarez's experience demonstrates the importance of finding ways to diffuse stress before it threatens your health and your ability to function.
examples.translation: 阿尔瓦雷斯的经历说明，在压力危及健康和正常生活能力之前设法将其化解十分重要。

examples.text: If you can respond with compassion, the situation will likely diffuse much faster.
examples.translation: 如果你能以同理心回应，局面很可能会更快缓和下来。

senses.gloss: 弥散的；分散的；广泛而不集中的

examples.text: Through a more diffuse "halo effect", its good deeds earn it greater consideration from consumers and others.
examples.translation: 通过一种更广泛而分散的“光环效应”，它的善举会使消费者等群体更加关注它。

examples.text: Nobody likes to feel that they've made a poor decision, especially if making intelligent decisions is a quality you hold in high esteem.
examples.translation: 没有人愿意觉得自己做了糟糕的决定，尤其当你非常看重“做出明智决定”这种品质时。

examples.text: It has to do with a hunger for the respect and esteem that is only available in our societies through the acquisition of material goods.
examples.translation: 这与人们渴望获得尊重和敬重有关，而在我们的社会中，这些往往只能通过获取物质财富来获得。

examples.text: Star watchers were among the most esteemed members of Hawaiian society.
examples.translation: 观星者曾是夏威夷社会中最受尊敬的成员之一。

meanings.text: 明显的；显而易见的；清楚可见的

senses.gloss: 明显的；显而易见的；清楚可见的

examples.text: The need of training is too evident and the pressure to accomplish a change in their attitude and habits is too urgent.
examples.translation: 培训的必要性十分明显，而改变他们态度和习惯的压力也极为迫切。

examples.text: This tendency in the natural sciences has long been evident in the social sciences too.
examples.translation: 自然科学中的这种趋势，长期以来在社会科学中也十分明显。

examples.text: This is evident in how we have organized ourselves into various collective groups such as nations, regions, communities, organizations, and families.
examples.translation: 这一点从我们如何组织成国家、地区、社区、组织和家庭等各种群体中就能清楚看出。

meanings.text: 擅长；表现突出；胜过他人

senses.gloss: 擅长；表现突出；胜过他人

examples.text: If you really want to excel at self-mastery, try to avoid ending up in the same situation as Mischel's poor preschoolers.
examples.translation: 如果你真想在自我控制方面表现出色，就尽量避免陷入米歇尔实验中那些学龄前儿童的处境。

examples.text: Left-brained people are supposedly logical and excel at language and math.
examples.translation: 据说“左脑型”人逻辑性强，并擅长语言和数学。

examples.text: Both Rachel and Peter excelled in their academic pursuit.
examples.translation: 瑞秋和彼得在学业追求中都表现十分出色。

examples.text: That ruling produced an explosion in business-method patent filings.
examples.translation: 那项裁决导致商业方法专利申请数量激增。

examples.text: Orin Kerr compares the explosion and accessibility of digital information in the 21st century with the establishment of automobile use in the 20th.
examples.translation: 奥林·克尔把 21 世纪数字信息的爆炸式增长和易获取性，与 20 世纪汽车使用的普及相比较。

examples.text: We were kept afloat by peak TV, the glut of content that was required by the explosion of streaming services.
examples.translation: 流媒体服务的迅猛增长带来了海量内容，而所谓“电视黄金高峰”正是靠这些内容维系的。

examples.text: Following the explosion of creativity in Florence during the 14th century known as the Renaissance, the modern world saw a departure from what it had once known.
examples.translation: 14 世纪佛罗伦萨爆发了被称为文艺复兴的创造力浪潮，此后现代世界开始脱离过去的旧有形态。

examples.text: It activates their evolved fear system and their unique fantasy.
examples.translation: 它会激活人类进化形成的恐惧系统以及独特的想象能力。

examples.text: Our society is still struggling to separate truth from fantasy, fact from fiction.
examples.translation: 我们的社会仍在努力区分真相与幻想、事实与虚构。

examples.text: On display here are various fantasy elements whose reference, at some basic level, seems to be the natural world.
examples.translation: 这里展示了各种幻想元素，而它们在某种基本层面上似乎都以自然世界为参照。

examples.text: A Polish digital artist uses classical painting styles to create dreamy fantasy landscapes.
examples.translation: 一位波兰数字艺术家用古典绘画风格创作梦幻般的奇幻景观。

examples.text: It doesn't have to be a hard fantasy novel with actual spells.
examples.translation: 它不一定非得是一部真正写有魔法咒语的硬核奇幻小说。

examples.text: One clergyman learned this in confronting folk along the coast who mocked that they had not come to the New World for religion.
examples.translation: 一位牧师在面对沿海居民时明白了这一点，那些人嘲讽说自己来新大陆并不是为了宗教。

examples.text: Unhappy childless folks are bothered with the message that children are the single most important thing in the world.
examples.translation: 没有孩子且生活不快的人常被一种观念困扰：孩子才是世界上最重要的东西。

examples.text: One of the most prominent features of creative folks is their lesser interest in socialising.
examples.translation: 富有创造力的人一个很突出的特点，是他们对社交的兴趣较低。

examples.text: A tide of emigration, one of the great folk wanderings of history, swept from Europe to America.
examples.translation: 一股移民潮——历史上规模巨大的民族迁徙之一——从欧洲席卷至美洲。

meanings.text: 强大得令人敬畏的；令人望而生畏的

senses.gloss: 强大得令人敬畏的；令人望而生畏的

examples.text: He is an unpretentious musician with no air of the formidable conductor about him.
examples.translation: 他是一位朴实低调的音乐家，身上没有那种令人敬畏的大指挥家气势。

examples.text: Science had the formidable slogan it needed to command public attention.
examples.translation: 科学终于有了一个足够有号召力的强大口号，可以吸引公众注意。

examples.text: It will be the most formidable of its kind in over a century.
examples.translation: 它将成为一个多世纪以来同类中最强大、最令人敬畏的一个。

examples.text: The language of Shakespeare may be formidable for pupils.
examples.translation: 莎士比亚的语言对学生来说可能很难应付。

meanings.text: 脆弱的；易受伤害的；不稳固的

senses.gloss: 脆弱的；易受伤害的；不稳固的

examples.text: Several historians reveal the moral compromises made by the nation's early leaders and the fragile nature of the country's infancy.
examples.translation: 几位历史学家的著作揭示了这个国家早期领导人的道德妥协，以及国家初创时期的脆弱性。

examples.text: They did not always prioritize the protection of Mauna Kea's fragile ecosystems.
examples.translation: 他们并不总是优先保护莫纳克亚山脆弱的生态系统。

examples.text: They were a symbol of fragile life, of hope and defiance.
examples.translation: 它们象征着脆弱的生命，也象征着希望与抗争。

examples.text: Placing fragile foods on plates would be incredibly slow.
examples.translation: 把易损的食物摆放到盘子里会非常缓慢。

examples.text: Newton's laws of motion and Darwinian evolution each bind a host of different phenomena into a single explicatory framework.
examples.translation: 牛顿运动定律和达尔文进化论都把大量不同现象纳入一个统一的解释框架。

examples.text: The whole framework of the billable hour makes it feel naggingly expensive to do anything non-billable.
examples.translation: 按小时计费的整个制度框架，会让任何不能计费的事情都显得格外“昂贵”。

examples.text: When there isn't the right framework in place, we face a greater likelihood of derailing our hard-earned progress.
examples.translation: 如果没有合适的框架，我们辛苦取得的进展就更容易偏离轨道。

examples.text: The European Union Framework funding programs have long had a category specifically targeted at social scientists.
examples.translation: 欧盟框架资助计划长期以来一直设有专门面向社会科学家的类别。

meanings.text: 转换思路；改变方式；切换状态

examples.text: Wear protective gear when applying chemicals.
examples.translation: 施用化学品时要穿戴防护装备。

examples.text: Teachers should stop trying to gear some lessons toward auditory learners.
examples.translation: 教师不应再试图专门调整某些课程来迎合所谓的“听觉型学习者”。

examples.text: The advice here has been geared toward someone who wants to help an unhappy person.
examples.translation: 这里的建议主要是针对那些想帮助不快乐者的人。

senses.gloss: 转换思路；改变方式；切换状态

examples.text: The brain switches gears and starts rewiring to become more efficient.
examples.translation: 大脑会切换运作方式，并开始重新建立连接以提高效率。

examples.text: The more one repeats a task, the more difficult it feels to shift gears and transition to something new.
examples.translation: 一个任务重复得越多，就越难转换思路并过渡到新的做法。

examples.text: In poetry, the highly personal, performative genre is the only form that could claim real liveliness.
examples.translation: 在诗歌领域，高度个人化、强调表演性的体裁似乎是唯一真正有活力的形式。

examples.text: It's quite remarkable how different genres of music can spark unique feelings, emotions, and memories.
examples.translation: 不同音乐流派能够唤起各不相同的感受、情绪和记忆，这一点相当奇妙。

examples.text: They are more open to new genres of music.
examples.translation: 他们更愿意接触新的音乐类型。

meanings.text: 图形的；图像的；平面设计的

senses.gloss: 图形的；图像的；平面设计的

examples.text: Companies are vacuuming up all the graphics processing unit computer chips they can to build vast data centres.
examples.translation: 各家公司正在大量抢购图形处理器芯片，用于建设庞大的数据中心。

examples.text: Graphic design becomes possible at scale.
examples.translation: 平面设计开始可以实现规模化生产。

examples.text: He abandoned architecture to try to carve out a career as a graphic artist.
examples.translation: 他放弃了建筑学，尝试以平面艺术家的身份开创事业。

examples.text: The team used robotics, sonar mapping, and state-of-the-art graphics to survey the site.
examples.translation: 团队利用机器人技术、声呐测绘和先进图像技术对现场进行了勘测。

examples.text: Most readers don't care whether the graphic accompanying a magazine article was drawn by a person or a computer.
examples.translation: 大多数读者并不在意杂志文章配图究竟是人画的还是电脑生成的。

examples.text: Progress has halted in recent years.
examples.translation: 近年来，进展已经停滞。

examples.text: We persevere investing in a project that should be halted.
examples.translation: 我们会继续给一个本该中止的项目投入资源。

examples.text: It would have halted if company and government had not worked together.
examples.translation: 如果企业和政府没有合作，它本来会停下来。

examples.text: This can mean an abrupt halt in productivity as employees take time to recover.
examples.translation: 员工需要时间恢复，这可能意味着生产效率突然中断。

meanings.text: 普通的；不起眼的；地位低微的
使谦逊；挫败；羞辱；使认清自己的局限

examples.text: "Humble" is to "noble".
examples.translation: “卑微的”与“高贵的”相对应。

examples.text: As much as I'm humbled and honoured to give her a leg up, I'm terrified that she will be living with us for a long time.
examples.translation: 虽然能帮她一把让我既受宠若惊又深感荣幸，但我也很担心她会长期和我们住在一起。

senses.gloss: 使受挫；使失去傲气；使认清局限

examples.text: It is understandable to anticipate a frisson of schadenfreude at the thought of big tech's super-rich boss class being humbled.
examples.translation: 想到科技巨头那些超级富有的老板们可能受挫，人们产生一丝幸灾乐祸也可以理解。

examples.text: Today a humble bag of crisps is manufactured in an assembly line.
examples.translation: 如今，就连一袋普通不起眼的薯片也是在流水线上生产出来的。

examples.text: The idea that some groups of people may be more intelligent than others is one of those hypotheses that dare not speak its name.
examples.translation: 某些群体可能比另一些群体更聪明这一观点，是一种人们往往不敢公开说出的假说。

examples.text: Psychologists call this the "analytical rumination hypothesis," and it is supported by research.
examples.translation: 心理学家把这种观点称为“分析性反刍假说”，而且有研究支持它。

examples.text: There is a hypothesis that doing crossword puzzles improves working memory.
examples.translation: 有一种假说认为，做填字游戏能够改善工作记忆。

examples.text: Our null hypothesis was that 0% of participants would turn down the opportunity to switch to a more enjoyable task.
examples.translation: 我们的零假设是，没有参与者会拒绝转而去做更有趣任务的机会。

meanings.text: 富有想象力的；有创造力的；善于想象的

senses.gloss: 富有想象力的；有创造力的；善于想象的

examples.text: But humans are uniquely imaginative, and we use our evolved imagination to travel into virtual worlds that are full of danger.
examples.translation: 但人类拥有独特的想象力，我们会利用进化而来的想象能力进入充满危险的虚拟世界。

examples.text: Left-brained people are supposedly logical while right-brained people are more imaginative.
examples.translation: 据说“左脑型”人更讲逻辑，而“右脑型”人更富有想象力。

examples.text: Our ultimate duty remains to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone who ever crosses our path.
examples.translation: 我们最终仍有责任对几乎每一个与自己相遇的人保持善意、正直、好奇和想象力。

examples.text: They did not always prioritize Mauna Kea's holiness to the island's inhabitants.
examples.translation: 他们并不总是优先尊重莫纳克亚山对岛上居民而言的神圣意义。

examples.text: We are amazed today at the number of dramatists writing at the same time for this London of two hundred thousand inhabitants.
examples.translation: 今天我们仍会惊讶于当时竟有如此多剧作家同时为这个只有二十万居民的伦敦创作。

examples.text: Tromsø is home to approximately 70,000 inhabitants, making it the second-most populated city north of the Arctic Circle.
examples.translation: 特罗姆瑟约有 7 万居民，是北极圈以北人口第二多的城市。

examples.text: Their reactions may be a complex combination of instant reflexes, past driving experiences, and what their eyes and ears tell them.
examples.translation: 他们的反应可能是即时反射、过去驾驶经验以及当下视觉和听觉信息的复杂结合。

examples.text: The answer lies in our addiction to instant gratification.
examples.translation: 答案在于我们对即时满足的迷恋。

examples.text: The same molecule that hooks us on apps that dispense instant hits of pleasure also encourages us to value things that require a lot of work.
examples.translation: 让我们沉迷于提供即时快感的应用的同一种分子，也会促使我们重视那些需要付出大量努力的事情。

examples.text: Our mental health can be temporarily hidden from view, but it is fully capable of being restored in an instant.
examples.translation: 我们的心理健康可能暂时被遮蔽，但完全能够在一瞬间恢复。

examples.text: She has used forgotten crops such as moringa and bambara groundnut to make everything from instant soup to Indian snacks.
examples.translation: 她利用辣木、班巴拉花生等被遗忘的作物制作从速食汤到印度小吃等各种食品。

examples.text: A number of companies use AI image processing technology to inspect infrastructure and prevent equipment failure or leaks before they happen.
examples.translation: 许多公司利用人工智能图像处理技术检查基础设施，在设备故障或泄漏发生前加以预防。

examples.text: A gas leak caused one of the signal lights to explode.
examples.translation: 一次燃气泄漏导致其中一盏信号灯爆炸。

examples.text: Some of this loss of confidence, irritability and increased worry was leaking into personal relationships and non-work activities as well.
examples.translation: 这种自信心下降、易怒和忧虑加重，也逐渐渗入并影响到人际关系和工作之外的活动。

examples.text: These takeoff shots require a wide-angle lens, which means he must be less than 2cm from the butterfly.
examples.translation: 这些起飞瞬间的照片需要使用广角镜头，这意味着他必须离蝴蝶不到 2 厘米。

examples.text: Looking at the problem through this lens, a degree of inbuilt lethargy and the desire for shortcuts makes a lot of sense.
examples.translation: 从这个视角看，某种与生俱来的惰性以及走捷径的欲望就很容易理解了。

examples.text: Putting past events back under the microscope but with a more adaptive lens can help you see them as part of your life's coherent story.
examples.translation: 用一种更具适应性的视角重新审视过去的经历，可以帮助你把它们看作自己连贯人生故事的一部分。

examples.text: Now, examine your situation through the lens of each of these facets of yourself.
examples.translation: 现在，从自我的这些不同侧面分别审视你的处境。

examples.text: The greater the potential consumers, the higher the likelihood of a better price.
examples.translation: 潜在消费者越多，获得更好价格的可能性就越高。

examples.text: Spending more on player salaries does not significantly increase a team's likelihood of winning.
examples.translation: 在球员薪资上花更多钱并不会显著提高球队获胜的可能性。

examples.text: The likelihood of success is highest when workouts are simple, on a consistent schedule, and free of judgment.
examples.translation: 当锻炼方式简单、时间安排稳定且没有评判压力时，成功坚持下去的可能性最高。

examples.text: He led the U.S. Department of Energy's Loan Programs Office from 2021 to 2025.
examples.translation: 他在 2021 至 2025 年间领导美国能源部贷款项目办公室。

examples.text: The Nvidia chips have a limited shelf life, potentially shorter than that of the loan agreements.
examples.translation: 英伟达芯片的使用寿命有限，甚至可能短于相关贷款协议的期限。

examples.text: Passion-seekers from wealthy families can wait for a job they love without worrying about student loans in the meantime.
examples.translation: 家境富裕的求职者更能等待自己热爱的工作，而不必同时担心学生贷款。

examples.text: Artifacts in public museums should be sanctioned as having been obtained on loan, legally purchased, or obtained by treaty.
examples.translation: 公共博物馆中的文物应当被确认是通过借用、合法购买或条约方式取得的。

examples.text: A reasoned exchange through which we all gain mutual respect and understanding changes the very nature of what it means to win an argument.
examples.translation: 一种让双方都获得相互尊重和理解的理性交流，会改变“赢得争论”本身的含义。

examples.text: This mutual gaze is a major part of the attachment between mother and child.
examples.translation: 这种相互凝视是母婴依恋关系的重要组成部分。

examples.text: On the topic of trade, productive debates might be possible, in contrast to the familiar mutual condemnation on other issues.
examples.translation: 在贸易问题上，建设性的辩论或许是可能的，这与其他问题上常见的相互谴责形成对比。

meanings.text: 讨厌的；令人不快的；恶劣的

senses.gloss: 讨厌的；令人不快的；恶劣的

examples.text: A new problem threatens to earn them the sort of nasty headlines that inevitably lead to heads rolling in the executive suite.
examples.translation: 一个新问题可能让他们登上极其难看的新闻头条，并最终导致高管丢掉职位。

examples.text: The court did suggest that accepting favors in return for opening doors is distasteful and nasty.
examples.translation: 法院确实表示，以提供便利来换取好处的做法令人反感且恶劣。

examples.text: They suffer more often than most people from a number of nasty genetic diseases, such as breast cancer.
examples.translation: 他们比大多数人更容易患上一些严重的遗传性疾病，例如乳腺癌。

examples.text: This warm, moist environment can host fungi and bacteria, which can cause nasty skin and toenail infections.
examples.translation: 这种温暖潮湿的环境会滋生真菌和细菌，从而引发严重的皮肤和趾甲感染。

examples.text: I have never once been sorry for passing on the opportunity to retaliate with a nasty zinger.
examples.translation: 我从未后悔放弃用一句刻薄尖锐的话进行报复的机会。

meanings.text: 养育；后天培养；环境影响

examples.text: The seed lending library nurtures locally adapted plant varieties and fosters community resilience.
examples.translation: 种子借阅库培育适应当地环境的植物品种，并增强社区韧性。

examples.text: Nurturing a few solid relationships may ultimately be better for you than constantly filling your life with endless chatting.
examples.translation: 培养几段稳固的人际关系，最终可能比不断用无休止的聊天填满生活更有益。

examples.text: People who were highly analytical were often drawn to mates who tended to be empathetic, nurturing, trusting and prosocial.
examples.translation: 高度理性分析型的人往往会被富有同理心、善于关怀他人、值得信赖且亲社会的伴侣吸引。

examples.text: The latter step would largely offset the financial burden of annually pre-funding retiree health care.
examples.translation: 后一步骤将在很大程度上抵消每年预先为退休人员医疗保健拨款带来的财务负担。

examples.text: To offset this bias, deliberately refocus your thinking on the gains so you can more objectively weigh the alternatives.
examples.translation: 为了抵消这种偏差，可以有意识地把注意力重新集中到收益上，从而更客观地权衡各种选择。

examples.text: You can sell carbon credits to companies keen to offset their emissions.
examples.translation: 你可以把碳信用出售给希望抵消自身排放的公司。

meanings.text: 经常性开支；运营成本；管理费用

senses.gloss: 经常性开支；运营成本；管理费用

examples.text: Overhead may be high and circulation lower, but rushing to eliminate its print edition would be a mistake.
examples.translation: 虽然运营成本可能很高、发行量也较低，但仓促取消纸质版仍会是一个错误。

examples.text: Ultimately the chance to reduce overheads by employing fewer people or at lower rates will be what attracts big brands to technology.
examples.translation: 最终，通过减少雇员人数或降低用工成本来削减日常开支，才是吸引大品牌采用这项技术的原因。

examples.text: Even in this willfully unproductive use of leisure time, work hovers overhead like a ghost.
examples.translation: 即使是在这种刻意不追求产出的休闲时间里，工作仍像幽灵一样盘旋在头顶。

examples.text: I see the spinning pinwheel of the Milky Way overhead.
examples.translation: 我看到头顶上方像旋转风车一样的银河。

examples.text: Thousands of pairs of fluttering wings came overhead.
examples.translation: 成千上万对拍动的翅膀从头顶飞过。

meanings.text: 看似合理的；貌似可信的
有可能成立的；说得通的

senses.gloss: 看似合理的；貌似可信的

examples.text: People have been given a list of plausible statements, whose veracity they are asked to judge.
examples.translation: 受试者会拿到一组看似可信的陈述，并被要求判断其真实性。

examples.text: The biological explanation is plausible.
examples.translation: 这种生物学解释是说得通的。

examples.text: We have not yet found conclusive evidence, but this is the most plausible explanation.
examples.translation: 我们尚未找到决定性证据，但这是目前最可信的解释。

examples.text: Sharpening judgment by absorbing and reflecting on law is a desirable component of a journalist's intellectual preparation for his or her career.
examples.translation: 通过学习并反思法律来磨炼判断力，是记者职业知识准备中值得提倡的一部分。

examples.text: Executives have been framing a shrinking or flat workforce as preparation for an increasingly AI-driven economy.
examples.translation: 企业高管一直把员工规模缩减或停滞解释为对日益由人工智能驱动的经济所做的准备。

examples.text: Trigger warnings do not lead to any form of emotional or mental preparation.
examples.translation: 触发警告并不会带来任何形式的情绪或心理准备。

examples.text: The costs both of subscriptions and of these article preparation costs had been steadily rising above inflation.
examples.translation: 订阅费用以及这些文章制作费用一直以高于通胀的速度上涨。

examples.text: Attempts have been made to incorporate some measure of quality as well as quantity into the assessment of an applicant's papers.
examples.translation: 人们一直尝试在评估申请者论文时，同时把质量和数量纳入衡量。

examples.text: Shift from quantity to quality.
examples.translation: 从追求数量转向追求质量。

examples.text: As with many things, quality reigns over quantity.
examples.translation: 和许多事情一样，质量胜过数量。

examples.text: Some natural substances present in juice can be toxic in high quantities.
examples.translation: 果汁中存在的一些天然物质在大量摄入时可能具有毒性。

examples.text: Slop is digital content of low quality that is produced, usually in quantity, by means of artificial intelligence.
examples.translation: “Slop”指通常借助人工智能批量生成的低质量数字内容。

examples.text: There is an undue reliance amongst many journalists on interpretations supplied to them by lawyers.
examples.translation: 许多记者过度依赖律师向他们提供的解释。

examples.text: Young people's reliance on social media led to greater political engagement.
examples.translation: 年轻人对社交媒体的依赖带来了更高程度的政治参与。

examples.text: Countries can reduce their reliance on imported foods by investing in neglected local plants.
examples.translation: 各国可以通过投资被忽视的本地作物，减少对进口食品的依赖。

examples.text: The sort of nasty headlines that inevitably lead to heads rolling in the executive suite.
examples.translation: 那种难看的新闻头条往往最终会导致高管被撤职。

examples.text: So long as the rest of the economy keeps rolling, it is difficult to imagine the labour market keeling over.
examples.translation: 只要经济其他部分继续向前运转，就很难想象劳动力市场会突然崩溃。

examples.text: The new law rolls back the landmark California Environmental Quality Act.
examples.translation: 这项新法律削弱并撤回了具有里程碑意义的《加州环境质量法》中的部分规定。

examples.text: Once participants were on a roll with the tedious transcription task, nearly a quarter chose not to switch to a fun game.
examples.translation: 一旦参与者在枯燥的抄写任务中进入连续顺手的状态，近四分之一的人选择不切换到有趣的游戏。

examples.text: You should definitely roll out of bed to look at a blood moon if one is going to be visible in your region.
examples.translation: 如果你所在地区能看到血月，那绝对值得从床上爬起来去看。

examples.text: Burning down an entire house just to reclaim the nails underlines how scarce, costly and valuable the technology was.
examples.translation: 为了回收钉子而烧掉整栋房子，凸显出这种看似简单的技术当时多么稀缺、昂贵而珍贵。

examples.text: For hunter-gatherers, food, and therefore energy, was scarce and inconsistently available.
examples.translation: 对狩猎采集者而言，食物以及由此获得的能量十分稀缺，而且供应并不稳定。

examples.text: Some people kill lemurs and other wild animals when other food sources are scarce.
examples.translation: 当其他食物来源不足时，一些人会捕杀狐猴和其他野生动物。

examples.text: Much attention is focused on the sustainability of our cities and scarce attention is paid to the countryside.
examples.translation: 人们把大量注意力放在城市可持续发展上，却很少关注乡村。

examples.text: Limiting or disrupting the attention one pays to a task may help them seize opportunities to switch to something more fun and enjoyable.
examples.translation: 限制或打断对任务的注意力，可能有助于人们抓住机会，转而去做更有趣、更愉快的事情。

examples.text: Jackson had his little plantation seized by the Clarke County Sheriff's office and auctioned off to settle the mortgage.
examples.translation: 杰克逊的小种植园被克拉克县治安官办公室查封并拍卖，用于偿还抵押贷款。

examples.text: The Vermont Senate voted 26 to 4 against allowing an extension.
examples.translation: 佛蒙特州参议院以 26 比 4 的票数反对批准延期。

examples.text: The French Senate passed a digital services tax.
examples.translation: 法国参议院通过了一项数字服务税。

examples.text: In quick succession, the Senate and House passed legislation protecting Yellowstone in early 1872.
examples.translation: 1872 年初，参议院和众议院接连通过了保护黄石地区的立法。

examples.text: The slight increase in scale can look pretty cool.
examples.translation: 这种尺度上轻微的增大看起来会相当有趣。

examples.text: The story appeared in the local paper several times, with slight alterations in wording.
examples.translation: 这个故事曾多次出现在当地报纸上，每次措辞都有轻微改动。

examples.text: Even if Americans quit eating meat altogether, the resulting reduction of greenhouse gases in the US would be slight.
examples.translation: 即使美国人完全停止吃肉，美国温室气体排放的相应降幅也会很小。

examples.text: Many settlers had slighter religious commitments than Dane's.
examples.translation: 许多定居者的宗教信念并不像戴恩那样坚定。

meanings.text: 即兴的；未经事先安排的

examples.text: Spontaneous smiles were relatively easy to capture by the 1890s.
examples.translation: 到 19 世纪 90 年代，自然流露的笑容已经相对容易被相机捕捉。

examples.text: Both prompted and spontaneous apologies can help repair kids' relationships.
examples.translation: 无论是经提醒后道歉，还是自发道歉，都有助于修复孩子之间的关系。

examples.text: There's joy in the fact that young children are spontaneous and live life in the moment.
examples.translation: 年幼的孩子自然率真、活在当下，这本身就令人感到快乐。

senses.gloss: 即兴的；未经事先安排的

examples.text: If a friend shows up for a spontaneous ride, you might just say yes and be more likely to enjoy it.
examples.translation: 如果朋友临时邀你出去兜风，你也许会直接答应，而且更可能从中获得乐趣。

meanings.text: 随后的；后来的；之后发生的

senses.gloss: 随后的；后来的；之后发生的

examples.text: Prior knowledge and interests influence what we experience, what we think our experiences mean, and the subsequent actions we take.
examples.translation: 既有知识和兴趣会影响我们的经历、我们对经历的理解，以及随后采取的行动。

examples.text: Students retake a course and do better in subsequent courses.
examples.translation: 学生重修一门课程后，往往能在后续课程中表现得更好。

examples.text: These prescribed burns make subsequent wildfires less severe.
examples.translation: 这些计划性燃烧会降低随后发生的野火的严重程度。

examples.text: It is financially terrifying, psychologically embarrassing and extraordinarily hard to get support.
examples.translation: 这在经济上令人恐惧，在心理上令人难堪，而且极难获得支持。

examples.text: When it comes to born-digital information, the terrifying answer can be: if not librarians and archivists, then no one.
examples.translation: 对于原生数字信息，一个可怕的答案可能是：如果图书管理员和档案管理员不来保存，那就没人会保存。

examples.text: When dogs go missing it's a terrifying experience for them.
examples.translation: 狗走失对它们来说是一种非常可怕的经历。

examples.text: I'm terrified that she will be living with us for a long time.
examples.translation: 我很害怕她会长期和我们住在一起。

examples.text: I'm slightly terrified I will be relegated to a lower rank and overtaken by other friends.
examples.translation: 我有点害怕自己会在朋友心中的位置下降，被其他朋友超过。

meanings.text: 无疑；毫无疑问地；肯定地

senses.gloss: 无疑；毫无疑问地；肯定地

examples.text: Progress in both areas is undoubtedly necessary for the social, political and intellectual development of these societies.
examples.translation: 这两个领域的进步无疑是这些社会在社会、政治和思想层面发展所必需的。

examples.text: Even if there have been no disasters yet, things are undoubtedly moving in the wrong direction.
examples.translation: 即使目前还没有发生灾难，事情也无疑正在朝错误的方向发展。

examples.text: The state of your mind undoubtedly affects the state of your body, and vice versa.
examples.translation: 你的心理状态无疑会影响身体状态，反过来也一样。

examples.text: Many young people actively seek out opposing viewpoints.
examples.translation: 许多年轻人会主动寻找与自己相反的观点。

examples.text: Your feed could show a genuine mix of viewpoints rather than an endless loop of similar content.
examples.translation: 你的信息流可以真正呈现多种不同观点，而不是无休止地重复相似内容。

examples.text: Each might have different viewpoints on how to lead one's lifestyle.
examples.translation: 每个人对于应当如何生活都可能有不同看法。

meanings.text: 值得的；值得花时间或精力的
使某事值得；使某事有意义

senses.gloss: 值得的；值得花时间或精力的

examples.text: It doesn't necessarily follow that one kind of reading is fuller, more advanced or more worthwhile than another.
examples.translation: 并不能因此断定一种阅读方式就一定比另一种更充实、更高级或更值得。

examples.text: Today's conveniences should help us move towards worthwhile goals, be they exercising, building a career, or raising a family.
examples.translation: 今天的便利条件应当帮助我们朝着值得追求的目标前进，无论是锻炼身体、发展事业还是养育家庭。

examples.text: If a disclaimer can help even just a few people avoid unwanted content, McGirt thinks they're worthwhile.
examples.translation: 如果免责声明哪怕只能帮助少数人避开不想看到的内容，麦吉尔特也认为它们是值得的。

meanings.text: 本质上；实质上；归根结底

senses.gloss: 本质上；实质上；归根结底

examples.text: The Administration was in essence asserting that no state should be allowed to carry out Congress's immigration wishes.
examples.translation: 政府实质上是在主张，任何州都不应被允许执行国会在移民问题上的意图。

examples.text: In essence, these place names originally meant something like 'dwelling place of the Goodman clan.'
examples.translation: 从本质上说，这些地名最初的含义大致是“古德曼氏族的居住地”。

examples.text: In essence, sarcasm is easy while true, harmless wit takes talent.
examples.translation: 归根结底，挖苦很容易，而真正无害的机智则需要才华。

examples.text: An apparent case is real estate.
examples.translation: 一个明显的例子就是房地产。

examples.text: The asset bubble was focused on US real estate.
examples.translation: 当时的资产泡沫主要集中在美国房地产市场。

examples.text: Jack Ewing decided to turn this large estate into an ecotourism destination.
examples.translation: 杰克·尤因决定把这片大型庄园改造成生态旅游目的地。

examples.text: This crowd mentality is strong enough for people to evade their known responsibilities.
examples.translation: 这种从众心理十分强烈，足以让人们逃避自己明知应承担的责任。

examples.text: The development of Elizabethan drama is of exceptional interest to students of literary history.
examples.translation: 伊丽莎白时代戏剧的发展对文学史研究者具有非同寻常的重要意义。

examples.text: Certain cooks possess an intangible element that can turn a meal from great to exceptional.
examples.translation: 有些厨师拥有一种难以言传的特质，能把一顿好饭提升到卓越的水平。

examples.text: Some sought to end the persecution of other faiths.
examples.translation: 一些人试图结束对其他宗教信仰的迫害。

examples.text: Such debates reflect fierce discussions across the US.
examples.translation: 这些争论反映了美国各地围绕这一问题展开的激烈讨论。

examples.text: A wizard with a sword fights a fierce dragon.
examples.translation: 一名持剑的巫师与一条凶猛的巨龙战斗。

meanings.text: 令人印象深刻的；令人赞叹的

senses.gloss: 令人印象深刻的；出色的；非凡的

examples.text: The early settlers of Massachusetts Bay included men of impressive education and influence in England.
examples.translation: 马萨诸塞湾的早期定居者中，有些人在英国拥有非凡的学识和影响力。

examples.text: The tool allows anyone to create impressive images based on text prompts.
examples.translation: 这款工具让任何人都能根据文字提示生成令人惊叹的图像。

examples.text: So how do canines accomplish such impressive journeys?
examples.translation: 那么，犬类是如何完成如此令人惊叹的旅程的呢？

examples.text: Congress has always envisioned joint federal-state immigration enforcement.
examples.translation: 国会一直设想由联邦和州联合开展移民执法。

meanings.text: 对……的执迷；挥之不去的执念

examples.text: It swiftly became an obsession as he recovered from a successful operation to remove the cancer.
examples.translation: 在他接受癌症切除手术并顺利康复期间，这件事很快成了他的痴迷。

examples.text: A key obstacle is 'the obsession with imported products'.
examples.translation: 一个关键障碍是“对进口产品的迷恋”。

examples.text: Our obsession with looks has reached an unprecedented peak.
examples.translation: 我们对外貌的痴迷已经达到前所未有的高峰。

meanings.text: 引用某人的话或某项资料

examples.text: Premiers love to quote Mr. Romanow's report selectively.
examples.translation: 各省省长喜欢有选择地引用罗曼诺先生的报告。

examples.text: Quite a lot, according to a handful of scientists quoted in the News Feature.
examples.translation: 据该新闻特写中援引的几位科学家所说，数量相当多。

examples.text: The number of times a paper has been quoted elsewhere in the scientific literature...
examples.translation: 一篇论文在其他科学文献中被引用的次数……

examples.text: The lay press generates both health scares and short-lived dietary enthusiasms.
examples.translation: 大众媒体既会引发健康恐慌，也会掀起短暂的饮食热潮。

examples.text: Constant health scares just ... with no one listening.
examples.translation: 接连不断的健康恐慌最终只会让人们不再理会。

examples.text: Your memories of past events don't have to scare you or make you feel like a failure.
examples.translation: 对过去事件的记忆不必让你害怕，也不必让你觉得自己是个失败者。

examples.text: Broadcast music made workmen whistle new tunes.
examples.translation: 广播音乐让工人们吹起了新的曲调。

examples.text: Standing in the shoes of others fine tunes our social understanding.
examples.translation: 设身处地为他人着想能够微调并提升我们的社会理解能力。

examples.text: The brain essentially tunes out the rods' activity.
examples.translation: 大脑实际上会屏蔽视杆细胞的活动。

examples.text: Your brain goes like an old TV tuned to nothing.
examples.translation: 你的大脑就像一台没有调到任何频道的老电视。

examples.text: The most far-reaching change has been the decline in the scope and seriousness of arts coverage.
examples.translation: 影响最深远的变化，是艺术报道的范围和严肃性不断下降。

examples.text: The Supreme Court has narrowed the scope of protections for patent holders.
examples.translation: 最高法院缩小了对专利权人保护的范围。

examples.text: When social scientists do tackle practical issues, their scope is often local.
examples.translation: 当社会科学家确实着手研究实际问题时，他们的研究范围往往局限于当地。

examples.text: The Romans left behind a curious treasure: 10 tons of nails, nearly a million of the things.
examples.translation: 罗马人留下了一批奇特的宝藏：10 吨钉子，数量接近一百万枚。

examples.text: The idea that one might burn down an entire house just to reclaim the nails underlines how scarce and valuable the technology was.
examples.translation: 有人甚至会烧掉整栋房子只为回收钉子，这凸显了这种看似简单的技术当时有多么稀缺和珍贵。

examples.text: Nail manufacturers found more efficient ways to turn steel into nails.
examples.translation: 钉子制造商找到了更高效的把钢材制成钉子的方法。

meanings.text: 为……取得专利；授予专利保护

examples.text: Thousands of patents have been granted for what are called business methods.
examples.translation: 过去十年里，所谓的商业方法已经获得了数千项专利。

examples.text: It has the potential to eliminate an entire class of patents.
examples.translation: 这有可能取消整整一类专利。

examples.text: Morgan sold the patent to General Electric.
examples.translation: 摩根把这项专利卖给了通用电气。

examples.text: The nation's top patent court appears ready to scale back on business-method patents.
examples.translation: 美国最高级别的专利法院似乎准备收紧商业方法专利。

examples.text: That ruling produced an explosion in business-method patent filings.
examples.translation: 那项裁决导致商业方法专利申请数量激增。

examples.text: Harold C. Wegner is a patent attorney and professor.
examples.translation: 哈罗德·C·韦格纳是一名专利律师兼教授。

senses.gloss: 为……取得专利；授予专利保护

examples.text: The computer programs a company uses may be patented.
examples.translation: 公司使用的计算机程序可能受到专利保护。

examples.text: One inventor patented a technique for lifting a box.
examples.translation: 一位发明者为一种抬箱子的技术申请并取得了专利。

examples.text: Garrett Morgan came up with an affordable, patented traffic signal.
examples.translation: 加勒特·摩根发明了一种价格可承受且已获专利的交通信号装置。

examples.text: I'd accidentally taken a nap.
examples.translation: 我不小心打了个盹。

examples.text: We always encourage naps to be brief: 20 minutes or less.
examples.translation: 我们一直建议把小睡控制得很短：20 分钟或更少。

examples.text: A power nap can be just what you need to get through the afternoon.
examples.translation: 一次短暂的补觉也许正是你熬过下午所需要的。

examples.text: Try to avoid spicy, acidic and fatty foods before napping.
examples.translation: 小睡前尽量避免食用辛辣、酸性和高脂肪食物。

meanings.text: 最大的；最高的；最大限度的

senses.gloss: 最大的；最高的；最大限度的

examples.text: Theory suggests that the maximum sustainable yield comes when the biomass is about 50% of its original levels.
examples.translation: 理论表明，当生物量约为原始水平的 50% 时，可以获得最大可持续产量。

examples.text: An outdated way of thinking is 'maximum effort = maximum results.'
examples.translation: 一种过时的思维方式是“最大努力 = 最大成果”。

examples.text: To reach maximum output, you need to refrain from giving maximum effort.
examples.translation: 为了达到最大产出，你反而需要避免一直付出最大努力。

examples.text: Genetic maximums can change, but don't expect this to happen soon.
examples.translation: 遗传上的上限是可以改变的，但不要指望这种变化很快发生。

meanings.text: 外省地区；首都以外地区

examples.text: Instead of each province having its own list of approved drugs, all would pool resources.
examples.translation: 不再由每个省各自制定获批药品清单，而是让所有省份整合资源。

examples.text: The national agency would negotiate on behalf of all provinces.
examples.translation: 这个全国性机构将代表所有省份进行谈判。

examples.text: Ferraro analyzed forest loss in 7,468 villages across 15 provinces.
examples.translation: 费拉罗分析了分布在 15 个省的 7,468 个村庄的森林损失情况。

senses.gloss: 外省地区；首都以外地区

examples.text: What is true of London is even truer of the provinces.
examples.translation: 在伦敦成立的情况，在外省地区甚至更加明显。

examples.text: Protests have erupted over construction of the Thirty Meter Telescope.
examples.translation: 围绕三十米望远镜的建设爆发了抗议活动。

examples.text: Mauna Kea is home to some of the world's most powerful telescopes.
examples.translation: 莫纳克亚山拥有一些世界上威力最强大的望远镜。

examples.text: It was a musician who discovered Uranus by making his own telescope.
examples.translation: 发现天王星的是一位音乐家，他亲手制作了自己的望远镜。

examples.text: During the Polar Night, which lasts from November to January, the sun doesn't rise at all.
examples.translation: 在从 11 月持续到 1 月的极夜期间，太阳完全不会升起。

examples.text: The Polar Night in Tromsø is a time of beautiful colors and soft, indirect light.
examples.translation: 特罗姆瑟的极夜是一段充满美丽色彩和柔和间接光线的时期。

examples.text: Their stomachs contained the remains of caribou, polar bear, moose, narwhal and beluga.
examples.translation: 它们的胃里发现了驯鹿、北极熊、驼鹿、独角鲸和白鲸的残骸。

examples.text: Acid reflux is a common cause of nausea, dizziness and chest pain after resting.
examples.translation: 胃酸反流是休息后出现恶心、头晕和胸痛的常见原因。

examples.text: It is characterized by stomach acid traveling into the esophagus.
examples.translation: 其特征是胃酸反流进入食管。

examples.text: Less horizontal time means less time for stomach acid to irritate the esophagus.
examples.translation: 减少平躺时间，就能减少胃酸刺激食管的时间。

examples.text: Muscle also acts as a reserve of amino acids that the body can draw upon during illness or physiological stress.
examples.translation: 肌肉还充当氨基酸储备，身体在患病或承受生理压力时可以调用。

examples.text: Reduced muscle mass could limit the availability of amino acids needed by immune cells.
examples.translation: 肌肉量减少可能限制免疫细胞所需氨基酸的供应。

meanings.text: 巡回上诉法院；巡回法院

senses.gloss: 巡回上诉法院；巡回法院

examples.text: The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit would conduct a broad review of business-method patents.
examples.translation: 美国联邦巡回上诉法院将对商业方法专利展开广泛审查。

examples.text: The Federal Circuit issued an unusual order stating that the case would be heard by all 12 judges.
examples.translation: 联邦巡回上诉法院发布了一项不同寻常的命令，宣布该案将由全部 12 名法官审理。

examples.text: At issue before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit was the FCC's latest take on net neutrality.
examples.translation: 摆在美国哥伦比亚特区巡回上诉法院面前的问题，是联邦通信委员会对网络中立原则的最新立场。

examples.text: Tiny biological circuits transform those responses into the colors we see.
examples.translation: 微小的生物回路会把这些反应转化成我们看到的颜色。

examples.text: You may find yourself adopting a harsher, more sarcastic tone on social media than in real life.
examples.translation: 你可能会发现，自己在社交媒体上的语气比现实生活中更严厉、更尖刻。

examples.text: Many people who receive sarcastic comments feel put down and think the sarcastic person is rude.
examples.translation: 许多受到挖苦的人会觉得自己被贬低，并认为说讽刺话的人很无礼。

examples.text: Sarcastic statements are expressed in a cutting manner.
examples.translation: 讽刺性的话语通常以尖刻的方式表达。

examples.text: How can Britain's train operators justify yet another increase to rail passenger fares?
examples.translation: 英国铁路运营商怎么能为铁路客运票价再次上涨辩解呢？

examples.text: The cost of investing in and running the rail network should be borne by those who use it.
examples.translation: 投资和运营铁路网的成本应由使用铁路的人承担。

examples.text: Building rail lines in the middle of nowhere requires a big upfront investment.
examples.translation: 在人烟稀少的地方修建铁路线需要巨额前期投资。

examples.text: As a fellow environmentalist, animal-protection advocate and longtime vegetarian...
examples.translation: 作为一名同样关注环保、倡导动物保护并长期坚持素食的人……

examples.text: There are many reasons for either choosing animal protein or opting for a vegetarian selection.
examples.translation: 选择动物蛋白或素食选项都有许多不同的理由。

examples.text: Meat is more calorie-dense per serving than vegetarian options.
examples.translation: 每份肉类所含的热量通常高于素食选项。

meanings.text: 使有必要；使合理；成为……的正当理由

examples.text: The Supreme Court will consider whether police can search a mobile phone without a warrant during an arrest.
examples.translation: 最高法院将审议警方在逮捕过程中能否在没有搜查令的情况下搜查手机。

examples.text: It would not be overly burdensome for authorities to obtain a warrant to search through phone contents.
examples.translation: 要求执法部门先取得搜查令再检查手机内容，并不会造成过重负担。

examples.text: They could protect the phone data while waiting for a warrant.
examples.translation: 他们可以在等待搜查令期间采取措施保护手机数据。

senses.gloss: 使有必要；使合理；足以成为理由

examples.text: Sleep issues and habit issues can each be signs of things that warrant professional help.
examples.translation: 睡眠问题和习惯问题都可能表明情况已经需要专业帮助。

examples.text: A sunset is similar enough in different places to warrant almost universal appeal.
examples.translation: 不同地方的日落具有足够的相似性，因此几乎能获得普遍的吸引力。

meanings.text: 强势的；积极进取的；积极主动的
好斗的；攻击性的；侵略性的

senses.gloss: 强势的；积极主动的；咄咄逼人的

examples.text: The most important and aggressive promoter of gambling in America is the government.
examples.translation: 美国最重要、推动力度最强的赌博推广者是政府。

examples.text: In those situations, it's better to be more aggressive than less aggressive.
examples.translation: 在那些情况下，采取更积极、更强势的做法要比过于保守更好。

examples.text: The chaos and never-ending turmoil of everyday life is an aggressive obstacle in the pursuit of stable friendships.
examples.translation: 日常生活中的混乱和没完没了的动荡，是维持稳定友谊时一个强有力的阻碍。

examples.text: These new forms were at first mainly written by scholars and performed by amateurs.
examples.translation: 这些新形式起初主要由学者创作，并由业余爱好者表演。

examples.text: Organizations of amateurs and the traveling actors were all rivals in supplying dramatic entertainment.
examples.translation: 业余爱好者组织和巡回演员都在争相满足大众对戏剧娱乐的需求。

examples.text: Taking part in actually making music, even as a total amateur, has delivered benefits I could scarcely have imagined.
examples.translation: 亲自参与音乐创作，即使完全只是个业余爱好者，也给我带来了此前难以想象的益处。

examples.text: The amateur tradition in music criticism has been in headlong retreat.
examples.translation: 音乐评论领域的业余传统一直在迅速衰退。

examples.text: Each province has limited bargaining power.
examples.translation: 各省单独谈判时的议价能力有限。

examples.text: They could bargain for better drug prices.
examples.translation: 他们可以通过谈判争取更优惠的药品价格。

examples.text: There's no change to collective bargaining at the USPS.
examples.translation: 美国邮政署的集体谈判制度没有变化。

examples.text: Banks are reluctant to buy all those supposed bargains.
examples.translation: 银行也不愿购买那些所谓的便宜资产。

examples.text: The sweater descended from fashion shows to the bargain bin.
examples.translation: 这件毛衣从时装秀一路流行到商店的特价商品区。

examples.text: There are other key groups championing agricultural diversity.
examples.translation: 还有一些重要组织正在倡导农业多样性。

examples.text: A restaurant champions locally-sourced food in Kuala Lumpur.
examples.translation: 吉隆坡的一家餐厅积极推广本地采购的食材。

examples.text: Strengthening neighborhoods and championing the cultural lives of communities are big responsibilities.
examples.translation: 加强社区建设并推动社区文化生活，是重大的责任。

examples.text: Donkeys are champions when it comes to carrying stuff.
examples.translation: 说到驮运东西，驴堪称佼佼者。

examples.text: It's been a quarter of a century since a computer beat world champion Garry Kasparov.
examples.translation: 自计算机击败世界冠军加里·卡斯帕罗夫以来，已经过去了四分之一个世纪。

examples.text: Libraries are community builders, centers for the arts, and champions of youth.
examples.translation: 图书馆是社区建设者、艺术中心，也是青少年的支持者和倡导者。

meanings.grammar: That's your cue to do sth.
meanings.text: 那就是你做某事的提示／信号

examples.text: Look for cues about how others perceive you.
examples.translation: 留意能够反映别人如何看待你的线索。

examples.text: Without any familiar visual cues to draw from, the dogs were likely navigating by Earth's magnetic field.
examples.translation: 在没有熟悉视觉线索可供利用的情况下，这些狗很可能依靠地球磁场导航。

examples.text: We have not yet found conclusive evidence that the dogs used magnetic cues for navigation.
examples.translation: 我们尚未找到决定性证据证明这些狗利用磁场线索进行导航。

examples.text: This is called your 'cue.'
examples.translation: 这就叫作你的“提示信号”。

examples.text: When 3 p.m. comes around, that's your cue to pour yourself a cup of hot water and drink that tea.
examples.translation: 下午三点一到，那就是提醒你倒一杯热水泡茶喝的信号。

examples.text: The moral code governs his activity.
examples.translation: 这种道德准则规范着他的行为。

examples.text: Perhaps the world's languages, music and customs are governed by universal features.
examples.translation: 也许世界上的语言、音乐和习俗都受到某些普遍特征的支配。

examples.text: Have we been conditioned to accept a world governed by 'smart' tech?
examples.translation: 我们是否已经被训练得习惯接受一个由“智能”技术支配的世界？

examples.text: The state-level bodies that govern the profession have been too conservative to implement them.
examples.translation: 管理这一职业的州级机构一直过于保守，没有实施这些措施。

examples.text: Zoos are constantly evolving to improve how they care for animals and protect each species in its natural habitat.
examples.translation: 动物园不断改进动物照护方式，并保护各物种在其自然栖息地中的生存。

examples.text: They move between a variety of habitats, including forests, grasslands, woodlands and wetlands.
examples.translation: 它们会在森林、草地、林地和湿地等多种栖息地之间活动。

examples.text: Some species are too isolated to find suitable new habitat.
examples.translation: 有些物种彼此过于隔离，无法找到合适的新栖息地。

examples.text: People say there's a lag between taking your first bite and satisfying your hunger.
examples.translation: 人们常说，从吃下第一口食物到产生饱腹感之间存在时间差。

examples.text: The exact duration of the lag between when you eat and when you feel full depends on many factors.
examples.translation: 从进食到产生饱腹感之间具体会延迟多久，取决于许多因素。

examples.text: One can loosely speculate on the length of an average employee's lag time.
examples.translation: 我们可以粗略估计普通员工恢复状态所需的滞后时间。

examples.text: Lagging grid infrastructure struggles to transport this overabundance of green energy.
examples.translation: 落后的电网基础设施难以输送这些过剩的绿色能源。

examples.text: Meat consumption per person in these regions still lags that of developed countries.
examples.translation: 这些地区的人均肉类消费量仍低于发达国家。

examples.text: Any extension of the plant's license would be subject to Vermont legislature's approval.
examples.translation: 该工厂许可证的任何延期都必须得到佛蒙特州议会批准。

examples.text: None of them were licensed mental health professionals.
examples.translation: 他们中没有人是持证的心理健康专业人士。

examples.text: The researchers asked two licensed clinical psychologists to review each video.
examples.translation: 研究人员请两名持证临床心理学家审查每段视频。

examples.text: Cara Cara Goodwin, a licensed clinical psychologist, agreed that modeling apologies is essential.
examples.translation: 持证临床心理学家卡拉·卡拉·古德温认为，示范如何道歉十分重要。

examples.text: President Cyril Ramaphosa has streamlined licensing requirements.
examples.translation: 西里尔·拉马福萨总统已经简化了许可审批要求。

examples.text: Disciplines acquire a monopoly not just over the production of knowledge, but also over the production of the producers of knowledge.
examples.translation: 各学科不仅垄断知识的生产，也垄断知识生产者的培养。

examples.text: Utilities are granted a monopoly over their service territory in exchange for an obligation to serve every customer reliably.
examples.translation: 公用事业公司被授予其服务区域内的垄断权，以换取其可靠服务每一位客户的义务。

examples.text: Expanding monopoly control just when competitive alternatives are working would be a costly mistake.
examples.translation: 当有竞争力的替代方案正在发挥作用时扩大垄断控制，将是代价高昂的错误。

examples.text: They will belong to a private monopoly which developed them using public resources.
examples.translation: 它们将归一家利用公共资源开发它们的私人垄断企业所有。

examples.text: Here was the raw material of houses and furniture, ships and potash, dyes and naval stores.
examples.translation: 这里有建造房屋和家具、船只以及制造钾碱、染料和海军物资所需的原材料。

examples.text: Later civilisations would value the skilled blacksmith's labour in a nail even more than the raw material.
examples.translation: 后来的文明会认为，一枚钉子中熟练铁匠的劳动甚至比原材料本身更有价值。

examples.text: The sheer difficulty of maintaining old-world ways in a raw, new continent caused significant changes.
examples.translation: 在一个原始而崭新的大陆上维持旧大陆生活方式的巨大困难，引发了显著变化。

examples.text: Its robotic arms are programmed to prepare dishes from raw ingredients.
examples.translation: 它的机械臂被编程为使用未经加工的食材制作菜肴。

examples.text: These are mostly students who had no opportunity as children to travel to wilderness areas, wildlife refuges or national parks.
examples.translation: 这些人大多是学生，他们小时候没有机会前往荒野地区、野生动物保护区或国家公园。

examples.text: National Wildlife Refuge Barú looks nothing like the cattle ranch it was before 1987.
examples.translation: 巴鲁国家野生动物保护区已经完全看不出 1987 年以前作为养牛场的样子。

examples.text: Animals such as howling monkeys, scarlet macaws and even migratory cougars have returned to the refuge's land.
examples.translation: 吼猴、绯红金刚鹦鹉乃至迁徙的美洲狮等动物已经重返这片保护区。

examples.text: Giving people around my table a place where they feel they belong leads me to find my own refuge.
examples.translation: 让同桌的人拥有归属感，也使我找到了属于自己的心灵庇护所。

examples.text: It takes collective scrutiny and acceptance to transform a discovery claim into a mature discovery.
examples.translation: 一项发现主张需要经过集体审查和认可，才能成为成熟的科学发现。

examples.text: The manuscript will be flagged up for additional scrutiny by the journal's internal editors or outside peer reviewers.
examples.translation: 该稿件将被标记，由期刊内部编辑或外部同行评审者进一步审查。

examples.text: A finding that is too new may have so far escaped sufficient scrutiny.
examples.translation: 一项过于新颖的研究发现可能至今还没有经受充分审查。

examples.text: The idea of scrutiny is compounded by the dangers of comparison.
examples.translation: 被他人审视的感觉，又会因比较所带来的风险而加剧。

examples.text: Earlier, sterner generations explained such behaviour as weakness of will.
examples.translation: 更早、更严苛的几代人会把这种行为解释为意志薄弱。

examples.text: If the bar exam is truly a stern enough test for a would-be lawyer, those who can sit it earlier should be allowed to do so.
examples.translation: 如果律师资格考试对未来律师而言确实足够严格，那么能够提前参加考试的人就应被允许这样做。

meanings.text: 使适合特定需要；量身定制

examples.text: A tailor named John Dane, who emigrated in the late 1630s, left an account of his reasons for leaving England.
examples.translation: 一位名叫约翰·戴恩的裁缝在 17 世纪 30 年代末移民，并留下了自己离开英格兰原因的记述。

senses.gloss: 使适合特定需要；量身定制

examples.text: Teachers like to think that they can reach every student just by tailoring their instruction to match each student's preferred learning format.
examples.translation: 教师往往认为，只要根据每个学生偏好的学习方式调整教学，就能顾及每一位学生。

examples.text: Even as social media tailors itself to our individual tastes, it breeds a culture of sameness.
examples.translation: 即使社交媒体会迎合我们的个人口味，它也在滋生一种趋同文化。

examples.text: Tailored content is not all bad, and many of us would not want to permanently abandon personal relevance in our feeds.
examples.translation: 个性化定制的内容并非全无好处，许多人也不愿永久放弃信息流中的个人相关性。

examples.text: Growth demands calories and nutrients, notably protein, to feed expanding tissues.
examples.translation: 生长需要热量和营养物质，尤其是蛋白质，以供不断发育的组织所需。

examples.text: The average daily calorie intake of people in the rich world has risen to 3,500 calories.
examples.translation: 富裕国家人口的平均每日热量摄入已经升至 3500 卡路里。

examples.text: It's hard to make a compelling argument that the United States has a calorie deficit.
examples.translation: 很难令人信服地说美国存在热量摄入不足的问题。

meanings.text: 默认地；在没有其他选择的情况下

examples.text: Internet Explorer 10 would have DNT as a default.
examples.translation: Internet Explorer 10 将把“禁止追踪”设为默认选项。

examples.text: Human nature being what it is, most people stick with default settings.
examples.translation: 出于人的天性，大多数人都会沿用默认设置。

examples.text: Our default image of a passionate person seems to correspond to extroverted expressions of passion.
examples.translation: 我们对“充满激情的人”的默认印象，似乎更接近外向型的激情表达。

examples.text: Corporate-debt markets are pricing in ultra-low odds of default.
examples.translation: 公司债券市场所反映出的违约概率极低。

examples.text: Africa's forests are now emitting more CO2 than they absorb.
examples.translation: 非洲森林如今排放的二氧化碳已经多于其吸收量。

examples.text: The Amazon rainforest emitted more CO2 than it absorbed in several recent years.
examples.translation: 近几年中有数年，亚马孙雨林排放的二氧化碳多于其吸收量。

examples.text: They only considered the exhaust smoke emitted by finished cars, trucks, trains and planes.
examples.translation: 他们只考虑了成品汽车、卡车、火车和飞机排放的尾气。

examples.text: They sometimes jump collectively in their seats and emit high-pitched warning calls.
examples.translation: 它们有时会一起从座位上跳起，并发出尖锐的警告声。

examples.text: It is wise to take such gifts with gratitude and grace.
examples.translation: 以感激而从容的态度接受这样的馈赠是明智的。

examples.text: Gratitude for the anonymous men and women who make up the supply chain rarely makes its way into our consciousness.
examples.translation: 我们很少会意识到自己应当感谢那些构成供应链的无名男女。

examples.text: It's exceedingly difficult for human beings to feel gratitude toward strangers.
examples.translation: 人们很难对陌生人产生感激之情。

meanings.text: 睡眠惯性；刚醒时的迟钝状态

examples.text: Behind every well-intentioned plan lurks this dreaded sense of inertia.
examples.translation: 每一个出于好意的计划背后，都潜藏着这种令人畏惧的惰性感。

examples.text: Overcoming the behavioral inertia that prevents us from implementing new changes can benefit us in the long run.
examples.translation: 克服阻碍我们采取新改变的行为惰性，从长远看会让我们受益。

examples.text: It is of great benefit to us in the long term to conquer the inertia that stops us from making behavioral changes.
examples.translation: 克服阻碍我们改变行为的惰性，从长期来看非常有益。

senses.gloss: 睡眠惯性；刚醒时的迟钝状态

examples.text: Sleep inertia, characterized by dizziness, lightheadedness, nausea and disorientation, is one of the main reasons people feel sick after taking a snooze.
examples.translation: 睡眠惯性表现为眩晕、头昏、恶心和方向感混乱，是人们小睡后感到不适的主要原因之一。

examples.text: Most cases of sleep inertia are mild and resolve on their own after about 20 minutes.
examples.translation: 大多数睡眠惯性症状都较轻，并会在大约 20 分钟后自行消退。

meanings.text: 里格（旧长度单位，约三英里）

examples.translation: 如果视频中的说法与该手册不符，心理学家便进一步判断这些症状是否更符合其他情况。

examples.text: Random enlivening of a car journey or dull manual task.
examples.translation: 给驾车旅程或枯燥的体力劳动带来偶然的趣味。

examples.text: They could be manual or automatic.
examples.translation: 它们可以是手动的，也可以是自动的。

examples.text: The company provoked justified outrage in Vermont last week.
examples.translation: 这家公司上周在佛蒙特州激起了有充分理由的公愤。

examples.text: The algorithms curating our content are optimized for personal outrage.
examples.translation: 负责筛选内容的算法被优化为更容易激发个人愤怒。

examples.text: Outrage is one of the things that goes viral and keeps us engaged in social media applications.
examples.translation: 愤怒是最容易病毒式传播、并让我们持续沉浸于社交媒体的情绪之一。

examples.text: If he has a reputation for slacking, you might even be outraged.
examples.translation: 如果他一向有偷懒的名声，你甚至可能会感到愤怒。

examples.text: Monkeys are also outraged by slack rivals.
examples.translation: 猴子也会因偷懒的同伴而感到愤怒。

meanings.text: 一夜之间完成的；短期的

examples.text: The idea of overnight fluency appeals to our desire for immediate results.
examples.translation: “一夜之间达到流利”的想法迎合了人们追求立刻见效的心理。

examples.text: This executive's informal power shut down overnight.
examples.translation: 这名高管的非正式权力一夜之间便消失了。

examples.text: The rusty scaffolding around a nearby building vanishes overnight.
examples.translation: 附近建筑周围锈迹斑斑的脚手架会在一夜之间消失。

senses.gloss: 短期的；一夜之间完成的

examples.text: Undoing something that has become an automatic part of who we are takes more than an overnight effort.
examples.translation: 要改掉已经成为自身自动习惯的东西，绝不是一夜努力就能做到的。

meanings.text: 充满；蕴含（重要意义、结果等）

examples.text: The usual "Jennifer Aniston is pregnant" news.
examples.translation: 常见的“詹妮弗·安妮斯顿怀孕了”之类的新闻。

examples.text: News about pregnant celebrities is entertaining.
examples.translation: 有关怀孕名人的新闻很有娱乐性。

examples.text: The last pregnant female was documented in 1950.
examples.translation: 最后一次记录到怀孕的雌性是在 1950 年。

examples.text: Parallels that are pregnant with both warnings and lessons.
examples.translation: 这些相似之处既蕴含警示，也包含值得汲取的教训。

examples.text: His affair with a slave stained his prestige.
examples.translation: 他与一名奴隶的私情损害了他的声望。

examples.text: These upstart entrepreneurs cannot buy their prizes the prestige of the Nobels.
examples.translation: 这些暴发户式的企业家买不来诺贝尔奖所具有的那种威望。

examples.text: The careers of scientists and the reputation of their institutions depend on the number and prestige of the papers they produce.
examples.translation: 科学家的职业发展和其机构的声誉，取决于他们发表论文的数量与影响力。

meanings.text: 成为……的受害者；沦为猎物

examples.text: Today's vessels can find their prey using satellites and sonar.
examples.translation: 如今的船只可以利用卫星和声呐寻找猎物。

examples.text: Not all the prey is believed to be from scavenging.
examples.translation: 人们认为这些猎物并非全都来自食腐行为。

examples.text: These creatures prey only on "worthless" species.
examples.translation: 这些动物只捕食所谓“没有价值”的物种。

examples.text: This simulation gives the child crucial information about how to avoid becoming prey.
examples.translation: 这种模拟让孩子获得如何避免成为猎物的重要信息。

examples.text: How to avoid falling prey to an attacker.
examples.translation: 如何避免成为袭击者的受害者。

examples.text: They're often prone to reading too deeply into any given situation.
examples.translation: 他们往往容易对任何特定情境作过度解读。

examples.text: With the country entering a recession, the U.S. workforce was derided as poorly educated.
examples.translation: 随着该国进入经济衰退期，美国劳动力被嘲讽为受教育程度不足。

examples.text: As the recession is looming large, people are getting anxious.
examples.translation: 随着经济衰退的阴影日益逼近，人们开始感到焦虑。

examples.text: A significant part of the world is experiencing another great recession.
examples.translation: 世界相当一部分地区正在经历又一次严重的经济衰退。

meanings.text: 导致某种结果的因素；造成……的配方

examples.text: Tan's job is to create recipes with these still-unfamiliar ingredients.
examples.translation: 谭的工作是用这些仍较陌生的食材设计食谱。

examples.text: I try to modernise forgotten crops instead of using old recipes.
examples.translation: 我尝试让被遗忘的作物现代化，而不是沿用旧食谱。

examples.text: They attach little importance to recipes.
examples.translation: 他们不太重视食谱。

examples.text: Like a cookbook, it will provide a foolproof recipe.
examples.translation: 它会像烹饪书一样提供一个万无一失的方法。

examples.text: The region's dry climate and depleted soils would be a recipe for disaster.
examples.translation: 该地区干旱的气候和贫瘠的土壤很可能会酿成灾难。

examples.text: "It's a really hard thing to do," Peretti remarked.
examples.translation: 佩雷蒂评论道：“这确实是一件很难做到的事。”

examples.text: "Clearly AI is going to win," Kahneman remarked in 2021.
examples.translation: 卡尼曼在 2021 年评论道：“显然，人工智能会赢。”

examples.text: If I need to react to a rude in-person remark or mean online comment, I try to respond with courtesy and dignity.
examples.translation: 如果我需要回应当面的无礼言论或网上刻薄的评论，我会尽量以礼貌和尊严作答。

examples.text: Witty statements are usually in response to someone's unhelpful remarks or behaviors.
examples.translation: 机智的话通常是对他人无益言论或行为的回应。

examples.text: Witty remarks are delivered with undisguised and harmless humor.
examples.translation: 机智的评论以毫不掩饰但无害的幽默表达出来。

examples.text: Just how people think is still far too complex to be understood, let alone reproduced.
examples.translation: 人的思维方式仍复杂得难以理解，更不用说复制出来了。

examples.text: Many 5-to-9 video creators end up reproducing a version of the thing they are trying to distance themselves from.
examples.translation: 许多“下班后副业”视频创作者最终又复制出一种自己原本想摆脱的生活模式。

examples.text: Scholars reproduced 100 experiments published in three highly influential psychology journals.
examples.translation: 研究者复现了三本高影响力心理学期刊上发表的 100 项实验。

examples.text: Scientists still have no idea where the sharks reproduce.
examples.translation: 科学家至今仍不知道这些鲨鱼在哪里繁殖。

meanings.text: 抵抗的；抗拒的；有抵抗力的

examples.text: Today's immigration is neither at unprecedented levels nor resistant to assimilation.
examples.translation: 如今的移民规模既没有达到前所未有的水平，也并非抗拒同化。

examples.text: They are resistant to homogenization.
examples.translation: 它们抵制同质化。

examples.text: If people in the network just two degrees removed from the initial influential prove resistant, the cascade of change won't propagate very far.
examples.translation: 如果网络中与最初影响者只隔两层关系的人表现出抵抗力，这种连锁变化就不会传播得很远。

examples.text: Instead of providing a badly needed resolution, it only prolonged the fight.
examples.translation: 它没有给出迫切需要的解决办法，反而只是延长了争端。

examples.text: An associate professor of social psychology who specializes in conflict resolution.
examples.translation: 一位专门研究冲突解决的社会心理学副教授。

examples.text: It has issued a special resolution.
examples.translation: 它已经发布了一项特别决议。

examples.text: Did you make any resolutions this new year?
examples.translation: 今年新年你立下什么新年计划了吗？

examples.text: For that particular New Year's resolution, the deck is stacked against us.
examples.translation: 对于那项特定的新年决心而言，形势对我们并不有利。

examples.text: IQ tests ask you to deduce numerical sequences, among other similar tasks.
examples.translation: 智商测试会要求你推导数列，以及完成其他类似任务。

examples.text: He takes between 10,000 and 20,000 shots to get one butterfly take-off sequence in focus.
examples.translation: 为了拍清一组蝴蝶起飞的连续画面，他通常要拍一万到两万张照片。

examples.text: Looking at these DNA sequences, we get a biological testimony to the environment these animals lived in.
examples.translation: 通过观察这些 DNA 序列，我们获得了这些动物生存环境的生物学证据。

examples.text: It is increasingly easy to read donkeys' DNA sequences.
examples.translation: 读取驴的 DNA 序列正变得越来越容易。

meanings.text: 服务者；供人使用的工具（比喻）

examples.text: Few craftsmen or farmers, let alone dependents and servants, left literary compositions to be analyzed.
examples.translation: 很少有工匠或农民留下可供分析的文字作品，更不用说受赡养者和仆人了。

examples.text: His paternal grandparents had been servants, and Dickens later concealed their background.
examples.translation: 狄更斯的祖父母曾是佣人，后来他隐瞒了这段家庭背景。

examples.text: He would probably represent civil servants.
examples.translation: 他很可能会代表公务员群体。

examples.text: Jimmy Hoffa used to work as a civil servant.
examples.translation: 吉米·霍法过去曾是一名公务员。

senses.gloss: 服务者；供人使用的工具（比喻）

examples.text: Only then will they be useful servants and not Frankenstein's out-of-control monster.
examples.translation: 只有这样，它们才会成为有用的工具，而不是弗兰肯斯坦式失控的怪物。

meanings.text: 逐渐被理解；被充分意识到

examples.text: Earthquakes and tsunamis caused the city to sink.
examples.translation: 地震和海啸导致这座城市沉入水下。

examples.text: As it sinks in that top leaders have few places to escape to.
examples.translation: 随着人们逐渐意识到最高层领导者几乎无处可逃。

examples.text: Forests and shrubby woodlands have previously been one of the world's biggest carbon sinks.
examples.translation: 森林和灌木林过去一直是世界上最大的碳汇之一。

examples.text: The Amazon rainforest was also once a major carbon sink.
examples.translation: 亚马孙雨林也曾是一处重要碳汇。

examples.text: You never rise to the occasion, you only sink to the level of training.
examples.translation: 你不会临场自动超常发挥，只会退回到训练所达到的水平。

examples.text: In case there's an AI industry slump and they are left with idle and expensive new chip plants.
examples.translation: 以防人工智能行业出现低迷，使他们留下昂贵却闲置的新芯片工厂。

examples.text: She looks away, waves her arms in protest, slumps in the seat, and then begins to wail.
examples.translation: 她把脸转开，挥舞手臂表示抗议，随后瘫坐在座位上并开始大哭。

examples.text: Her fitness fell into a slump.
examples.translation: 她的身体状态陷入了低谷。

examples.text: Not to walk to the vending machine when your afternoon slump hit.
examples.translation: 当午后困倦袭来时，不要走向自动售货机。

examples.text: Not eating chocolate to beat your afternoon slump is a harder goal than swapping chocolate for herbal tea.
examples.translation: 用不吃巧克力来克服午后低迷，比把巧克力换成花草茶更难做到。

examples.text: They're all groaning about soaring health budgets.
examples.translation: 他们都在抱怨医疗预算飞速上涨。

examples.text: With current demand soaring, Samsung is in the comfortable position of being able to raise prices.
examples.translation: 随着当前需求猛增，三星处于可以从容提价的有利位置。

examples.text: Nvidia's share price soared from $13 at the start of 2021 to hit a peak of over $200.
examples.translation: 英伟达股价从 2021 年初的 13 美元飙升至超过 200 美元的峰值。

examples.text: The sharp rise in satellites soaring through low Earth orbit only worsens the problem.
examples.translation: 在近地轨道中高速飞行的卫星数量激增，只会让问题更加严重。

senses.gloss: 跨度；持续长度（尤指注意力、记忆等）

examples.text: After about 20 hours of training, his digit span had risen from 7 to 20.
examples.translation: 经过大约 20 小时的训练后，他的数字记忆广度从 7 提高到了 20。

examples.text: New digital technologies have shortened attention spans in financial markets.
examples.translation: 新的数字技术缩短了金融市场参与者的注意力持续时间。

examples.text: Family members commented on what they saw as her daughter's short attention span.
examples.translation: 家人提到了他们所观察到的她女儿注意力持续时间较短的问题。

examples.text: Within the span of a hundred years, a tide of emigration swept from Europe to America.
examples.translation: 在一百年的时间里，一股移民浪潮从欧洲席卷至美洲。

examples.text: His vast body of writings on music is unknown save to specialists.
examples.translation: 除了专业人士外，几乎没人了解他数量庞大的音乐著作。

examples.text: Make sure it's before noon, says longevity specialist Dr Brittany Busse.
examples.translation: 长寿研究专家布里塔妮·布斯博士说，要确保在中午之前摄入。

examples.text: It's not a theoretical proposition, says Walter Vergara, a forest and climate specialist.
examples.translation: 森林与气候专家沃尔特·韦尔加拉说，这并不是一个纯理论命题。

meanings.text: 精简；使效率更高；使流程更顺畅
精简高效的；流程简化的

senses.gloss: 精简；提高效率；简化流程

examples.text: AI could streamline the process of handling contracts with clients.
examples.translation: 人工智能可以简化处理客户合同的流程。

examples.text: Lawmakers streamlined building permits.
examples.translation: 立法者简化了建筑许可审批流程。

examples.text: President Cyril Ramaphosa has streamlined licensing requirements.
examples.translation: 西里尔·拉马福萨总统已经精简了许可要求。

examples.text: For businesses, this should mean better designs, more streamlined operations and fewer costly blunders.
examples.translation: 对企业而言，这应当意味着更好的设计、更精简高效的运营以及更少的高成本失误。

examples.text: Laws have often moved toward more streamlined permitting and denser housing.
examples.translation: 相关法律往往朝着更简化的审批和更高密度住房的方向发展。

meanings.text: 令人震惊的；令人惊叹的

senses.gloss: 令人震惊的；令人惊叹的

examples.text: It's a stunning move.
examples.translation: 这是一个令人震惊的举动。

examples.text: The expedition's stunning visuals.
examples.translation: 这次探险令人惊叹的影像。

examples.text: Veterans of previous expeditions had written at length about stunning sights.
examples.translation: 以往探险的参与者曾长篇描述那些令人惊叹的景象。

examples.text: At first, we thought they were teasing, but as we retraced our steps, we were stunned.
examples.translation: 起初我们以为他们在开玩笑，但当我们原路返回时，我们惊呆了。

examples.text: I was stunned by what I found out about this principle.
examples.translation: 我对自己了解到的这一原则感到十分震惊。

meanings.grammar: substitute A for B / substitute A with B
meanings.text: 用 A 代替 B；替换

examples.text: Recordings are no substitute for live performance.
examples.translation: 录音无法替代现场演出。

examples.text: There is still no substitute for shoe leather.
examples.translation: 实地走访仍然无可替代。

examples.text: You might decide to substitute another activity in its place.
examples.translation: 你可以决定用另一项活动来替代它。

examples.text: It may not be successful to simply substitute one activity with another to effect a change of habit.
examples.translation: 仅仅用一种活动替代另一种活动，未必能成功改变习惯。

meanings.text: 易受……影响的；易患……的；容易……的

senses.gloss: 易受影响；易患；容易遭受

examples.text: Women are particularly susceptible to developing depression and anxiety disorders in response to stress.
examples.translation: 女性在面对压力时尤其容易患上抑郁症和焦虑症。

examples.text: Shoes that are too loose can also make wearers susceptible to various issues.
examples.translation: 鞋子过松也会使穿着者更容易出现各种问题。

examples.text: We are all susceptible to the sunk-cost delusion.
examples.translation: 我们所有人都容易受到沉没成本错觉的影响。

examples.text: Their capacity for tolerating stress may even be greater than men's.
examples.translation: 她们承受压力的能力甚至可能比男性更强。

examples.text: Americans are willing to tolerate time-consuming security procedures in return for increased safety.
examples.translation: 美国人愿意忍受耗时的安检程序，以换取更高的安全性。

examples.text: People can learn to tolerate uncertainty, and even accept and perhaps embrace it.
examples.translation: 人们可以学会忍受不确定性，甚至接受乃至拥抱它。

meanings.text: 胜利；巨大成功；杰出成就

examples.text: John McWhorter sees the triumph of 1960s counter-culture as responsible for the decline of formal English.
examples.translation: 约翰·麦克沃特认为，20 世纪 60 年代反主流文化的胜利导致了正式英语的衰落。

examples.text: In both oral and written English, talking is triumphing over speaking, spontaneity over craft.
examples.translation: 在口语和书面英语中，随意交谈正压过正式表达，自发性也正胜过精心雕琢。

examples.text: Marlowe had brought poetry and genius to triumph on the common stage.
examples.translation: 马洛让诗歌与才华在大众舞台上取得了成功。

meanings.text: 维持（裁决、决定等）；确认有效

senses.gloss: 维持；确认有效（裁决、决定等）

examples.text: Too many patents were being upheld for inventions that are obvious.
examples.translation: 太多针对显而易见的“发明”的专利仍被维持有效。

examples.text: The appeals court unanimously upheld the 2017 order, citing a Supreme Court ruling from 2005 that upheld a similarly deregulatory move.
examples.translation: 上诉法院一致维持了 2017 年的命令，并援引了最高法院 2005 年维持类似放松监管举措的裁决。

examples.text: A system that was later upheld by Galileo at his own expense.
examples.translation: 这一体系后来由伽利略坚持并捍卫，而他也为此付出了代价。

examples.text: Libraries help by modeling and upholding the principles of free inquiry and expression for all.
examples.translation: 图书馆通过践行并维护人人享有自由探究和表达的原则来发挥作用。

examples.text: UK interests which enjoy advantage from the breadth of English usage would consequently face new pressures.
examples.translation: 那些因英语广泛使用而获益的英国利益方将因此面临新的压力。

examples.text: Increased usage of large language models is expected to lead to a certain convergence of styles.
examples.translation: 大型语言模型使用增加，预计会导致写作风格出现一定程度的趋同。

examples.text: The problem has been compounded by the abrupt shutdown of a government database with details on pesticide usage.
examples.translation: 一个记录农药使用情况等信息的政府数据库突然关闭，使问题更加严重。

meanings.text: 含糊的；模糊的；不明确的

senses.gloss: 含糊的；模糊的；不明确的

examples.text: Rather than cloaking his exit in the usual vague excuses, he came right out and said why he was leaving.
examples.translation: 他没有用惯常的含糊借口掩饰离职，而是直接说明了离开的原因。

examples.text: A turbulent business environment also has senior managers cautious of letting vague pronouncements cloud their reputations.
examples.translation: 动荡的商业环境也使高管们谨慎行事，以免含糊的言论损害自己的声誉。

examples.text: While the statement is vague, it represents one starting point.
examples.translation: 尽管这份声明很模糊，但它至少代表了一个起点。

meanings.text: 企业；项目；（有风险的）事业

examples.text: Such food service operators range from snack machines to large institutional catering ventures.
examples.translation: 这类餐饮服务经营者既包括零食自动售货机，也包括大型机构餐饮企业。

examples.text: If you're considering whether to shut down your entrepreneurial venture, reach out to other founders.
examples.translation: 如果你在考虑是否关闭自己的创业项目，可以去联系其他创业者。

examples.text: Sticking with the example of the entrepreneurial venture, numbers are your best friend.
examples.translation: 继续以创业项目为例，数据是你最可靠的帮手。

examples.text: Doctors began advising people to venture outside to escape the bad air in their homes.
examples.translation: 医生开始建议人们大胆走到户外，以躲避家中的“污浊空气”。

examples.text: The more people who witness an event, the less likely anyone will venture to participate.
examples.translation: 目击某一事件的人越多，就越少有人敢于参与其中。

examples.text: People might not be discerning about what aspect of their experience is A.D.H.D. versus something else.
examples.translation: 人们可能无法分辨自己的哪些体验属于多动症，哪些又是其他问题。

examples.translation: 一项研究比较了 12 个月大的婴儿独自玩耍与和父母一起玩耍时的注意力持续时间。

examples.translation: 交通运输与畜牧业的直接排放可以进行比较，分别约占 14% 和 5%。

examples.text: It is trying to set voluntary standards for models and fashion images.
examples.translation: 它正试图为模特和时尚图像制定自愿遵守的标准。

examples.text: The government is helping develop a voluntary code for the ethical use of AI.
